name: RECOIL-v2
mechanism: Matched-materiality 3D gate: stage promotion is no longer decided by ad-hoc per-axis thresholds but by a normalized, honest significance function over the full (length, status, timing) triple — a delta is 'material' only when it clears a joint significance bound derived from the family's own baseline noise, and the same gate is applied to the patched-control twin. Escalation promotes only on respect for the 3D gate.
what_it_does_previous_couldnt: RECOIL-v1 promotes on raw length/status deltas and a hand-tuned ORACLE_THRESHOLD; it cannot say WHY it promoted, and it has no honest bound on false promotion. The matched-materiality gate makes every promotion a falsifiable claim with a measured noise floor, and requires the patched twin to fail the same gate before a primitive is blessed.
fireback: The operator can now interrogate WHY the ladder climbed — every promotion cites its (len,status,ms) triple against the noise bound. Fireback = any stage that climbed on noise is exposed as such in the evidence journal; the tool cannot hide a fluke behind an escalation. The box is forced to justify each rung to the operator.
containment: Noise baselines are computed only from the bundled fixture's own responses (in-allowlist); the patched twin is a bundled control on loopback. The gate is a pure function of in-scope state vectors and never touches a destination outside the allowlist.
kill_switch: --gate-clear off flips the gate to permissive (audit-only) mode so no promotion is blocked; the 3D gate is fully recomputable from the evidence journal, and wipe SHA-verifies zero survivors after demotion.
novelty_angle: The RECOIL fireback loop gains an honest epistemology: every escalation is a tested 3D hypothesis about the target's response space, with a measured noise floor and a control twin required to disagree. 'Advance only on a delta the target itself must attest to' — evidence-gating made three-dimensional and self-auditing.
